# Limited-Time Offer: Double Credits on Your First Subscription, Plus Bonus Credits on Renewal and Upgrade
During the event, subscribe to the Lite, Pro, or Pro+ Personal plan for the first time to receive bonus Credits equal to the plan's monthly included Credits. Renew or upgrade a Personal plan to receive bonus Credits based on the plan.
## Event details
- **Start time**: October 21, 2026 at 00:00 (UTC+8)
- **End time**: To be announced. We'll announce the end date on this page in advance
- **Applicable site**: qoder.com
- **Eligible plans**: Lite, Pro, Pro+, and Ultra Personal plans
- **Not eligible**: Teams and Enterprise plans
- **How it works**: Bonus Credits are issued automatically after payment succeeds. No claim is required
[Subscribe on the Pricing page →](https://qoder.com/pricing)
## First subscription: Double Credits
If your account has never had a successful payment, subscribe to Lite, Pro, or Pro+ for the first time during the event to receive bonus Credits equal to the plan's monthly included Credits. Your account registration date does not matter, and subscribing during the Pro trial is eligible.
| Plan | Price | Monthly included Credits | Bonus Credits | First-month total |
| ----- | ---------- | ------------------------ | ------------- | ----------------- |
| Lite | 10 USD/mo | 1,000 Credits | 1,000 Credits | 2,000 Credits |
| Pro | 20 USD/mo | 2,000 Credits | 2,000 Credits | 4,000 Credits |
| Pro+ | 60 USD/mo | 6,000 Credits | 6,000 Credits | 12,000 Credits |
| Ultra | 200 USD/mo | 20,000 Credits | Not eligible | 20,000 Credits |
## Renewal and upgrade bonus
Renew, upgrade, or resubscribe after your subscription expires during the event to receive bonus Credits as follows.
### Renewal
| Plan | Monthly included Credits | Bonus Credits |
| ----- | ------------------------ | ------------- |
| Lite | 1,000 Credits | 500 Credits |
| Pro | 2,000 Credits | 1,000 Credits |
| Pro+ | 6,000 Credits | 2,000 Credits |
| Ultra | 20,000 Credits | 3,000 Credits |
### Upgrade
The upgrade bonus is based on the plan you upgrade to, regardless of your previous plan.
| Upgraded plan | Bonus Credits |
| ------------- | ------------- |
| Pro | 1,000 Credits |
| Pro+ | 2,000 Credits |
| Ultra | 3,000 Credits |
For example, upgrading from Lite to Pro grants 1,000 bonus Credits. Upgrading from Lite or Pro to Pro+ grants 2,000 bonus Credits.
NOTE: Resubscribing after your subscription expires is treated as a renewal, not a first subscription.
## How to participate
1. Sign in to Qoder.
2. Go to the [Pricing page](https://qoder.com/pricing), select a Personal plan, and complete payment.
3. Bonus Credits are usually added automatically within a few minutes after payment succeeds. Go to **Settings > Usage** to view your Credits details and expiration dates.
## FAQ
**Q: How is this event different from the previous one?**
Lite is now eligible for the first-subscription bonus. The renewal and upgrade bonus has changed from a flat 1,000 Credits for every plan to a plan-based amount: 500 for Lite, 1,000 for Pro, 2,000 for Pro+, and 3,000 for Ultra.
**Q: Which rules apply to orders paid on October 20, 2026?**
Eligibility is based on when the order payment succeeds. Orders paid before October 20, 2026 at 24:00 (UTC+8) follow the previous event rules. Orders paid from October 21, 2026 at 00:00 (UTC+8) follow the rules on this page.
**Q: I registered a long time ago but have never paid. Does this count as a first subscription?**
Yes. A first subscription is determined by whether the account has ever had a successful payment, not by its registration date.
**Q: I already have a Personal plan. Can I participate?**
Yes. Renew during the event to receive bonus Credits based on your current plan: 500 for Lite, 1,000 for Pro, 2,000 for Pro+, and 3,000 for Ultra. Upgrades are based on the plan you upgrade to.
**Q: I subscribed to Pro before. If I subscribe to Lite after Pro expires, does it count as a first subscription?**
No. Your account already has a successful payment, so you receive the Lite renewal bonus of 500 Credits.
**Q: Do I receive bonus Credits if my first subscription is Ultra?**
No. A first Ultra subscription is not eligible for the bonus. Renewing Ultra during the event grants 3,000 bonus Credits.
**Q: Which models can I use with bonus Credits?**
Bonus Credits can be used with the same models as your current plan. For example, bonus Credits on the Lite plan can only be used with models supported by Lite.
**Q: When will I receive the bonus Credits, and how long are they valid?**
They are issued automatically after payment succeeds and usually arrive within a few minutes. They are valid for 30 days from the time they are issued. Unused Credits expire automatically.
**Q: Will unused bonus Credits expire when the event ends?**
No. Bonus Credits already issued are not cleared early when the event ends, and remain available within their 30-day validity period.
**Q: Are Teams and Enterprise plans eligible?**
No. This event applies only to Personal plans.
## Event terms
These terms apply to qoder.com (the international site). For the qoder.cn offer, see the Qoder CN event page.
**Credits bonus**
1. **Event period**: The event starts on October 21, 2026 at 00:00 (UTC+8). The end date will be announced on this page in advance. Bonus eligibility is determined by whether the order payment succeeds during the event. Orders paid outside the event period are not eligible. Orders paid before October 20, 2026 at 24:00 (UTC+8) follow the previous event rules.
2. **Eligibility**: The Credits bonus applies only to monthly Personal plans. The first-subscription bonus applies to Lite, Pro, and Pro+. A first Ultra subscription is not eligible. Lite, Pro, Pro+, and Ultra subscriptions renewed, upgraded, or resubscribed after expiration during the event receive bonus Credits as described in Term 4. Bonus Credits can be used with the same models as your current plan. Teams, Enterprise, and other non-Personal plans are not eligible.
3. **First subscription**: An account qualifies for a first subscription if it has never had a successful payment. A refunded order still counts as a previous payment, so a later purchase is not treated as a first subscription.
4. **Bonus amount and issuance**: Bonus Credits are issued automatically after the order payment succeeds and usually arrive within a few minutes.
- First subscription: 1,000 Credits for Lite, 2,000 for Pro, 6,000 for Pro+, and 0 for Ultra.
- Renewal or resubscription after expiration: 500 Credits for Lite, 1,000 for Pro, 2,000 for Pro+, and 3,000 for Ultra.
- Upgrade: Based on the plan you upgrade to. 1,000 Credits for Pro, 2,000 for Pro+, and 3,000 for Ultra.
- The amount shown on the order confirmation page prevails for each order.
5. **Validity**: Bonus Credits are valid for 30 calendar days from the time they are issued, calculated in UTC+8. Unused Credits expire automatically and do not roll over. The end or early termination of the event does not affect bonus Credits already issued and still within their validity period.
6. **Refunds**: Orders with Credits consumed during the subscription period are non-refundable. If an order has no Credits consumed and meets the refund requirements, it can be fully refunded. After the refund, the subscription is canceled, unused bonus Credits are revoked, and the account is still considered to have made a previous payment.
**Other terms**
1. **Benefit restrictions**: Bonus Credits cannot be transferred, redeemed for cash, or invoiced.
2. **Abuse prevention**: Qoder may disqualify accounts involved in abnormal or bulk registration, fraudulent transactions, or other violations of the Terms of Service, and may revoke issued bonus Credits.
3. **Event changes**: Qoder reserves the right to adjust, suspend, or terminate this event and will provide notice by updating this page or through other official channels.
4. **Taxes and usage**: Prices exclude applicable taxes. For Credits usage and model pricing, see the Help Center and the Pricing page.
5. **Contact**: If you have questions, contact [contact@qoder.com](mailto:contact@qoder.com).
